name: Spring Rate Calculator
blurb: spring constant from wire diameter, coils and diameter
intro: The rate of a round-wire helical compression spring, k = d⁴G / 8D³Na, with its solid length, force and stress at solid and a buckling check. Wire strengths and allowable stresses are Shigley's (ASTM wire grades).

inputs.label: Working length
inputs.help: Compressed length in use; leave empty to skip.

examples.title: Shigley ex. 10-1: music wire 0.94 mm, OD 11.1 mm, 12.5 coils, squared ends

usage: Give the wire material and diameter d in mm, the coil diameter in mm (say whether outside, mean or inside), the coil count (total or active) and end type, and optionally the free and working lengths in mm. It returns the rate in N/mm, spring index, active and total coils, solid length, force and shear stress at solid against the allowable, the working force and a buckling warning. Use it to pick or check a compression spring for a mechanism.
sources: Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., chapter 10: eqs. 10-5, 10-7, 10-9, 10-10, 10-14; tables 10-1, 10-4, 10-5, 10-6
ASTM A228, A227, A229, A232, A401, A313, B159 spring wire grades
